live_gateway_configuration.reasoning_semantics: Requests extra_body.reasoning.enabled=false. A BadRequest can retry without this off-only compatibility setting; reasoning_requested then becomes null. This is not maximum-reasoning evaluation or independent backend attestation.
live_gateway_configuration.matched_prompts: Existing SYSTEM_PROMPT+STAGED_PROMPT/CAPABILITIES are used in both arms; fixed L1 seed is source admission, not a Qwen-selected loss or loss-skill experiment.

caps_and_conditions.shared_scope: File-role resolution and planner/EDA share one RunBudget started before load_inputs and solve; no phase reset.
caps_and_conditions.token_scope: max_tokens bounds requested output for EACH HTTP attempt. There is no separately enforced aggregate prompt+completion/currency cap. Initial8192 does not cap followup16384.
caps_and_conditions.actual_count_not_guaranteed: Roles usually resolve deterministically. Initial/followup calls require remaining solver reserve+90; followup also requires an empty initial queue/HPO completion and planner capacity. A limit of2 does not prove2 actual successful planner calls.
caps_and_conditions.timeouts_shared: All attempts/backoff share their logical timeout, clipped to the same solver RunBudget deadline.
caps_and_conditions.usage_unknowns: Retries may have unknown earlier usage. usage_complete=false must accompany incomplete counts; existing numeric zero fallback counters are not proof of zero actual usage.

ledger_and_response_paths.ledger_directory_allocation: Atomically unique tempfile name; exact path only known after actual RunBudget entry.
ledger_and_response_paths.initial_response: work/la1/{A|B}/{r|c}/automl_runs/repair4/initial-data-assessment.json: context, terminal_response, parsed plans, call and assessment.
ledger_and_response_paths.followup_receipt: work/la1/{A|B}/{r|c}/automl_runs/repair4/planner-{len(calls)}.json: normalized plans/rejections, context and call; raw followup terminal text is not separately retained by llm_plan.
ledger_and_response_paths.ledger_contents: Purposes/status/reservations/known attempts/reported counters/elapsed and closure status. No prompts, responses, credentials or input rows.
ledger_and_response_paths.core_seal_boundary: repair4 core and submission are sealed. run-budget-* is a sibling deliberately outside core_seal; R4 independently reads and hashes its exact report path.

R4_audit_boundaries.initial_EDA_checks: Valid nonempty data_assessment fields; cold-start feedback[] and best_recipe=null; stage before_any_model_fit; assessment_valid=true; saved hash agrees with supervisor first-worker observation.
R4_audit_boundaries.ledger_checks: Path must resolve inside task directory; independently read closed ledger must have gateway_call_limit4 and calls_started<=4. Noncompleted/incomplete usage adds api_usage_incomplete.
R4_audit_boundaries.permission_denied: Recorded explicitly with null independent usage/hash and no ACL bypass. Parent counters remain labelled non-independent; no zero imputation or silent completeness.
not_proved_by_R4_alone: A particular number of nonzero HTTP requests merely from max-call flags
Complete token/currency accounting after unknown retry usage
R4_audit_boundaries.new_Qwen_claim_requirement: Use new per-task actual EDA responses/call metadata plus closed task ledger/source/argv/first-worker hashes. Historical champion provenance and Stage0 mocked/pure checks are not actual new Qwen calls.
